texts.li: [soldier,lowtech] A weathered traveller with a soldier's walk is asking for {A_nameDef} by name. {X_nameDef} served beside {A_objective} in the old wars: the same mud, the same thin rations, the same terrible marching songs. {X_nameDef} has no war left to fight and nowhere left to go, and would like a place here.

[soldier,!lowtech] A drifter in a faded uniform comes up the road asking for {A_nameDef}. {X_nameDef} and {A_nameDef} served in the same unit, years ago and a long way from here. {X_nameDef} heard {A_nameDef} had settled down and walked a long way to see it with {X_possessive} own eyes. Now {X_nameDef} would like to stay.

[outlaw] Someone {A_nameDef} hoped never to see again, or hoped to see every day, is waiting by the gate. {X_nameDef} ran with {A_objective} in the bad old days. "I'm done with all that," {X_nameDef} says. "Same as you, I hear. Any room for one more honest soul?"

{X_nameDef} turned up at the treeline this morning, asking for {A_nameDef}. They knew each other before all this, back when there were fewer fences and more trouble. {X_nameDef} looks tired of the road, and asks if there's room for one more.

li.label: Welcome {X_nameDef}
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} drops {X_possessive} pack by the fire as if {X_pronoun} had never been away. {A_nameDef} hasn't stopped grinning.

li.label: Turn {X_objective} away
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} nods as if {X_pronoun} expected nothing else, and walks back the way {X_pronoun} came.

texts.li: A traveller at the edge of the colony asks for {A_nameDef}, won't give a reason, and won't leave. When {A_nameDef} comes out, the traveller just stands there. It's {X_nameDef}: {A_possessive} {RELATION}. They each thought the other was dead. {X_nameDef} has come a very long way, and has nowhere else to be.

[lowtech] A pilgrim with nothing but a walking stick has been asking at every village and crossroads for someone called {A_nameDef}. Today the answer was yes. {X_nameDef}, {A_possessive} {RELATION}, is waiting by the fields, and would like to stay.

[!lowtech] A message came over the comms days ago, asking after someone named {A_nameDef}. Nobody answered it. Now the sender is standing at the edge of the colony: {X_nameDef}, {A_possessive} {RELATION}, who followed a rumour across half a continent. {X_nameDef} asks to stay.

li.label: Bring {X_objective} in
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} hold on to each other for a long time. Nobody says anything about it.

li.label: Send {X_objective} on
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} walks away slowly, looking back. {A_nameDef} watches until there's nothing left to watch.

texts.li: [partner] Someone at the gate is asking for {A_nameDef}, who goes very quiet on hearing the name. They were together once, before all this, and {X_nameDef} has nowhere else to go. {A_nameDef}'s partner has already noticed the quiet.

{X_nameDef} is at the edge of the colony, asking for {A_nameDef}. They were together once, years ago, and it ended the way these things end. Now {X_nameDef} is alone on the road and asks if there's room here. {A_nameDef} says it's up to the council. The look on {A_possessive} face says something else.

li.label: Let {X_objective} stay
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} moves in. Whatever happens next, it won't be boring.

li.label: Not here
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} leaves without making a scene. {A_nameDef} doesn't talk about it.

IncidentDef.label: return of the one who left

texts.li: [quit] {X_nameDef}, who walked out on the colony, is standing at the edge of the fields with {X_possessive} pack and a speech {X_pronoun} has clearly practised. Life out there was harder than {X_pronoun} thought, and {X_pronoun} was wrong about some things. {X_nameDef} asks to come home. {A_nameDef} heard first, and is waiting to hear what the council says.

[banished] {X_nameDef}, who was sent away, has come back: thinner, quieter, and asking to be let in. "I know how it ended," {X_nameDef} says. "I'm asking anyway." {A_nameDef} heard first, and is waiting to hear what the council says.
{X_nameDef}, who once lived here, has come back and asks to be let in again. {A_nameDef} heard first, and is waiting to hear what the council says.

li.label: Let {X_objective} come home
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} is home. Some are glad. Some are watching.

texts.li: [outlaw] A sharp-eyed collector has tracked {A_nameDef} down. {A_nameDef} owes {COUNT} silver to some very patient people from {A_possessive} old life, and patience, the collector explains, has run out.

[trader] A creditor has found {A_nameDef}. Once upon a time a deal went wrong, {A_nameDef} left town in a hurry, and {COUNT} silver left with {A_objective}. The creditor would like it back, with or without a scene.
[noble] A clerk with a ledger and two very large companions has come about a debt of {A_nameDef}'s family: {COUNT} silver, owed for years and, as of today, owed by {A_objective}.

[!tribal] Someone has come asking for {A_nameDef}, holding a slip of paper with {A_possessive} old signature on it. {A_nameDef} owes {COUNT} silver from another life, and the creditor has come to collect.

[tribal] Someone has come asking for {A_nameDef}, carrying a tally stick notched with {A_possessive} old mark. {A_nameDef} owes {COUNT} silver from long ago, and the creditor has walked a long way to collect it.

li.label: Pay the {COUNT} silver
li.outcome: The creditor counts every coin twice and leaves. {A_nameDef} looks ten years younger.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} talk them down
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} talks for an hour. By the end the creditor is laughing, the debt is forgiven, and nobody is quite sure how it happened.
li.riskOutcome: {A_nameDef} talks. The creditor listens, then leaves without a word. That kind of silence usually comes back with friends.

li.label: Debt collectors
li.text: The creditor who came for {A_nameDef}'s old debt is back with friends from {ENEMY}, to collect another way.

li.label: Refuse
li.outcome: The creditor shrugs and leaves. Maybe that's the end of it.
li.riskOutcome: The creditor leaves, promising to come back. People like that keep their promises.

li.label: Debt collectors
li.text: The creditor who came for {A_nameDef}'s old debt is back with friends from {ENEMY}, to collect another way.

texts.li: [lowtech] A rider under a white rag stops just out of bowshot. {A_nameDef}, the rider shouts, is wanted for old crimes, with {COUNT} silver on {A_possessive} head, and {ENEMY} mean to collect it. Hand {A_objective} over, match the bounty, or they'll come in and take {A_objective}.

[lowtech] An arrow thuds into the gatepost with a message wrapped round it: {A_nameDef} is worth {COUNT} silver to {ENEMY}, for old crimes not forgotten. Send {A_objective} out, pay the price yourselves, or they'll come and get {A_objective}.

[!lowtech] A wanted poster, weighted with a stone, is waiting at the gate: {A_nameDef}'s face, {COUNT} silver, and a note from {ENEMY}. Hand {A_objective} over, match the bounty, or they'll come in and collect.

[!lowtech] The comms crackle with a flat, bored voice. There's a bounty of {COUNT} silver on {A_nameDef} for things done in another life, and a crew from {ENEMY} has come to collect. Hand {A_objective} over, match the bounty, or they'll come in and take {A_objective}.

li.label: We stand by {A_nameDef}
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} can't quite find the words. The hunters will be here within hours.

li.label: Bounty hunters
li.text: The bounty hunters have come for {A_nameDef}. They won't leave without a fight.

li.label: Pay them {COUNT} silver
li.outcome: The hunters take the silver, count it, and leave. {A_nameDef}'s old life is paid for.

li.label: Hand {A_nameDef} over
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} walks out to meet them without a word. Nobody watches {A_objective} go, and everybody does.

texts.li: [lowtech] A courier has come a long way with a bundle for {A_nameDef}: someone from {A_possessive} old life has died, and remembered {A_objective} at the end. The courier leaves it at {A_possessive} feet, wishes {A_objective} well, and goes.

[!lowtech] A drop pod thumps down near the colony, addressed to {A_nameDef}. Inside, with a short and very formal letter: everything a distant relative left behind, sent on to {A_possessive} last known address.

[noble,!tribal] Lawyers have found {A_nameDef} at last: an aunt nobody liked has died, and of everyone in the family, she remembered {A_objective}. The estate has been sent on, with the lawyers' compliments and their bill already deducted.

[lowtech] A travelling peddler brings {A_nameDef} a letter, much folded and rained on. It's from the old master who taught {A_objective} everything {A_pronoun} knows about {SKILL}: still alive, still opinionated, and full of advice {A_nameDef} immediately sets out to prove wrong.

[lowtech] A pedlar passing through has a message for {A_nameDef}, learned by heart from {A_possessive} old teacher of {SKILL}: a list of everything {A_nameDef} was always doing wrong, and one line at the end saying {A_pronoun} was the best student they ever had.

[!lowtech] A message finds its way to {A_nameDef}, bounced across half the world's relays: the teacher who taught {A_objective} {SKILL}, still alive, still opinionated, and full of advice {A_nameDef} immediately sets out to prove wrong.

[!lowtech] A battered data chip arrives with a trader's caravan, addressed to {A_nameDef}: hours of recorded notes on {SKILL} from {A_possessive} old teacher, who apparently never stopped thinking about how {A_nameDef} held the tools.
[farmer] Word reaches {A_nameDef} from the place {A_pronoun} grew up: the harvest was the best in living memory, and the old neighbours are all still there, still arguing about the same fence.
[soldier] Word reaches {A_nameDef} that the war {A_pronoun} once fought in is over at last, and the friends {A_pronoun} left behind made it home.
[noble] Word reaches {A_nameDef} that {A_possessive} family name has been cleared. Whatever was said back then, it has been unsaid.
[outlaw] Word reaches {A_nameDef} that the people who wanted {A_objective} found are gone: dead, jailed or simply bored of looking. {A_nameDef} sleeps better than {A_pronoun} has in years.
[lowtech] A traveller passing through brings news for {A_nameDef}: the people {A_pronoun} left behind are doing well, and someone there still asks after {A_objective}.
[!lowtech] A message finds its way to {A_nameDef} from the people {A_pronoun} left behind: everyone is well, someone got married, someone had a baby, and they all still ask after {A_objective}.
[lowtech] A traveller brings {A_nameDef} news nobody wants: the village {A_pronoun} came from was burned in a raid this year. There's nobody left there now.

[!lowtech,!spacer] A news broadcast, half lost in static, mentions a place {A_nameDef} recognises: {A_possessive} hometown, overrun in some war {A_pronoun} had never heard of. There's nothing left to go back to.
Word reaches {A_nameDef}, late and second-hand, that the place {A_pronoun} came from is gone. There's nothing left to go back to.
[spacer,!lowtech] Word reaches {A_nameDef} that the world {A_pronoun} came from has gone dark: no transmissions, no ships, nothing. Nobody knows what happened. Maybe nobody ever will.
